scope: 法术物品图标画风与中文显示名提案；未修改运行时资源、语言键或数值。

namingSchemes.arcane: ① 原初术式：短名、术式感、由说明补足精确机制。
namingSchemes.clear: ② 清晰奇幻：名字可以推测用途，兼顾独立世界观与易读性。
namingSchemes.relic: ③ 遗物铭文：法术以刻片/刻印/铭文为实物，适合探索获取。

namingRules: 保留穿刺、反弹、治疗等清楚的通用机制词，不以生僻词替代所有术语。
并咒表示同时施放多个法术链，拓印表示复制后方单卡，寄咒表示将独立术式储存在载体内。
尚未选择具体方案；各方案可与任意画风组合，不修改既有法术ID。
imageConstraints: 图片为画风概念板，非精确32×32像素资产，也非游戏截图。不能直接整体缩小替换资源。选定后先做六张真实32×32逻辑像素图标并检查16px物品栏可读性，再扩展全目录。
commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Minecraft magic mod inventory-icon art-direction proposal, NOT a screenshot and NOT a finished sprite export.
Create one beautiful, disciplined comparison board for one art direction, landscape composition around 1536 by 1024. Dark charcoal neutral flat background, six isolated LARGE pixel-art item icons in a spacious 3-column by 2-row grid. Main focus the six sprites, not presentation decorations. Make icons visually convincing as coarse logical 32x32 sprites enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels: crisp square pixels, strong chunky silhouettes, limited deliberate flat palette, 2-3 discrete shade bands per material, no gradients, no bloom, no blur, no soft particles, no anti-aliasing, no realistic texture noise, no micro-detail. Readable at inventory scale. These should feel like original collectable magic items, NOT modern app icons.
Identical subject order for all proposal boards: 1 top left a compact fire projectile/fire seed with clear ember core; 2 top middle concentrated light, three gathered rays becoming one bright spear; 3 top right an inward gravity core, asymmetrical inward bending pieces around a dark void, NOT a ringed planet; 4 bottom left a sharp circular rotating cutting blade with chunky teeth; 5 bottom middle a piercing modifier, one sharp projectile visibly passing through two slabs; 6 bottom right a double-cast instruction, one starting mark branching into two identical outgoing spell marks, NOT two playing cards. Each subject must have a distinct silhouette and clear functional metaphor. No shared circular badge, no enclosing coin, no ornate card frames, no generic plus-sign overlays, no Noita imagery, no game logos.
Top margin only the single requested large Latin option letter and its English title, small icon numerals 1 2 3 4 5 6 adjacent to the grid cells, no other lettering. Bottom margin one understated horizontal inventory strip repeating all six designs at a much smaller scale, crisp pixels, in simple grey Minecraft-like square inventory slots. Show the actual proposed sprite style again in miniature, not different sprites. The large sprites must remain the dominant visual area, with plenty of empty space between them.

Heavy chipped square-pixel stone silhouettes, dry stony texture expressed with only a FEW large pixels, warm limestone cuts and muted oxidized turquoise and ember ochre pigment inside the engraved shapes. minimalRevision.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: pixel-art spell inventory icon concept board, not implemented game assets.
Input image 1: edit target, previous D+ board. User likes its rich hard-edged pixel rendering and colors but rejects decorative objects and misleading mechanics.
Primary request: simplify ALL SIX icons so EACH icon depicts ONLY what that spell actually does. The icons are pictures of spells or their operations, NOT jeweled artifacts. Keep bold coarse pixel-art clusters and 2-3 hard shade bands, bone/ivory highlights and deep obsidian outline shadows ONLY where natural to the subject. Do not force ivory seal fragments onto every icon.
Keep original charcoal background, 3-column x 2-row composition, original heading "D+  SPECTRAL SEALS", labels 1-6, and bottom miniature six-slot inventory strip. Edit the large icons AND matching miniatures consistently. Reduce visual complexity substantially.
1 FIREBALL top left: ONE compact bright orange-red fireball with a small backward flame tongue and ivory-hot center. Remove all bone brackets, floating stone fragments, loose sparks, gem inlays and satellite objects. Only fire.
2 CONCENTRATED LIGHT top middle: ONLY ONE exceptionally straight thin horizontal ivory-white laser beam with a small hard-edged pale gold perimeter. Long narrow illuminated stripe with a slightly tapered end, completely clean uninterrupted horizontal silhouette. It must NOT be an arrow, spear or sword. NO branching or converging rays, no focus star, no launch device, no crescent brackets, no gems, no sparkle, no additional line or decorative motif. The whole icon is a single strong beam of light, without any surrounding objects. Keep enough length and contrast to read in miniature.
3 BLACK HOLE top right: preserve the favorite rich purple-blue inward spiraling magic and clearly black empty center, but simplify it to 3-4 broad inward-curving violet-indigo energy bands with crisp faceted planes. Remove ivory skeletal caps, all detached shards and sparkles. Compact single vortex, visually distinct from the circular metal saw. No orbiting rocks or planet ring.
4 SAWBLADE bottom left: ONLY one continuous steel-grey circular saw disk, clear small dark axle hole, 10-12 sharp perimeter teeth, ivory steel highlights and deep blue-grey shadows. Very small cyan edge accent allowed. Remove surrounding rotation arcs, loose particles, gem center, extra tools, and decoration. Instantly identifiable cutting saw with connected round blade.
5 PIERCING bottom middle: a simple sharp ivory/cyan projectile cleanly passes THROUGH ONE small plain dark slab, with the same projectile visible entering and exiting. Only these two necessary subjects. Remove second slab, purple crystal inlays, ornate needle hilt and particles. A single shaft crossing a thin barrier with a clear exit communicates piercing. Not a magic weapon collection.
6 DRAW TWO top right of lower row / bottom right: EXACTLY TWO SIMPLE RECTANGULAR SPELL CARDS offset and slightly fanned apart. Obsidian-purple blank faces, thin ivory edges, tiny teal corner tabs only, no face symbols. Both cards clearly visible as TWO cards being drawn. This spell only DRAWS TWO CARDS, so DO NOT show any lightning bolt, elemental symbol, beam, outgoing projectile, output arrow, spark, glow, star, magical effect, third card, deck pile, hand, wand, number, or text. The two cards alone are the entire icon; do not imply a specific spell type or damage.
Unity comes from pixel scale, deliberate silhouettes, dark shadows and consistent material highlight hues; NOT from adding unrelated props to every spell. Generous negative space between icons. At inventory size each is a single easy-to-recognize visual thought.
Constraints: hard opaque square pixels, crisp restrained shading, no anti-aliasing, blurred glow, gradients, tiny texture noise, floating debris, ornate shared badge, new labels, watermark. Board is a conceptual preview, not exact 32x32 export.

semanticRevision.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Minecraft magic mod pixel-art icon concept board, preview only.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: D+ SPECTRAL SEALS. Preserve overall layout, header, six numbered positions, background, materials, pixel-art style, and bottom inventory strip. Keep icons 1 (fire), 3 (purple crystalline inward black-hole vortex) and 5 (piercing needle through two slabs) unchanged. Change ONLY designs 2, 4 and 6, including their corresponding bottom thumbnails. User approves the style but these three fail to communicate their spell.
Maintain shared bone ivory and obsidian material accents, broad elemental colors, chunky pixel clusters and deliberate negative space. Function must be obvious before decoration, not every spell should be an abstract artifact.
2 top middle CONCENTRATED LIGHT: replace the three floating spearheads / three missiles with an unmistakable optics diagram embodied as magic: three thin distinct golden light rays arriving from the left at different heights, all visibly BENDING AND CONVERGING into one tight central white-gold focus, then ONE long straight bright narrow laser beam exiting toward the right. The main visual is the converging rays and resulting beam, not three solid objects. A small pair of bone/obsidian focusing fragments may bracket the focus, but no spear tips, arrowheads, three parallel projectiles, or bow. Clean horizontal silhouette, readable convergence, strong pale gold on charcoal. Hard-edged pixel light, no blurred glow.
4 bottom left SAWBLADE: replace the four/six separated curved petal blades and jewel hub with ONE UNMISTAKABLE SOLID CIRCULAR SAW DISK, nearly front-on with a very slight tilt. Broad connected steel-grey disk, around 10-12 sharp triangular asymmetric saw teeth along its continuous perimeter, a SMALL dark central axle hole (not a jewel/star). Bone-white tooth highlights, obsidian dark underside and restrained cyan edge inlay. Two short separated cyan motion arcs behind opposite edges suggest spinning, not a full surrounding ring. Must instantly read as a rotary cutting saw, NOT a shuriken, turbine, snowflake, flower, propeller, or many floating crescent swords. Saw teeth and continuous circular disk more important than matching open fragmentation.
6 bottom right DOUBLE CAST: remove the Y-shaped stick with gems completely. Show EXACTLY TWO rectangular spell cards or rune tablets fanned slightly apart, one offset up-left and one down-right, both distinct full silhouettes with no enclosing badge. Obsidian card faces, thin bone-ivory edges, each bearing the SAME SIMPLE TEAL MAGIC BOLT symbol. Two short identical teal/ivory outgoing spell streaks emerge side-by-side to the right, clearly communicating drawing and casting TWO spells at once. Two cards, two outputs, not ten cards; no Y staff or slingshot, no gem branch, no scissors. Large readable simple shapes, no text, numerals or tiny runes inside cards.
Composition: same six-icon 3x2 board, keep original numeral labels 1 through 6 and header EXACTLY "D+  SPECTRAL SEALS"; preserve existing sizes and spacing. Bottom strip must repeat revised icons 2,4,6 correctly alongside unchanged 1,3,5.
Constraints: crisp coarse square pixels, flat 2-3 shade bands per material, no fine painterly textures, anti-aliasing, soft light, bloom, gradients, transparency effects, realistic reflections, or extra labels. No in-game resource replacement implied.
